summary: Ansible's migration to the toolchain arch-validate is correct, and the 28-carrier enumeration reproduces against both gitblit and GitHub's trees. But four carriers classed 'no rollout' (ScanToPdfServer, ScanToPdfClient, MyDownloadsServer, MyDownloadsClient) start downstream jobs that pin into auto-synced prd deploy repos, so P11 would push them without D1's rollout-health gate.

findings.summary: ScanToPdfServer/Client and MyDownloadsServer/Client are classed 'no rollout' in P11, but their pushes start ScanToPdf, MyDownloads and Webathome, which pin into ScantopdfDeploy, MediaDeploy and WebathomeOrgDeploy (all auto-sync prd). P11 has no health gate for these rollouts, and batch 3 has two builds pinning MediaDeploy.
